mechanisms: Retain600cp safe-alternative veto for phase<=8 or raw mover material lead>=300; otherwise allow multiple winning middlegame options
Existing EC/mate corroboration also accepts exact legal mate-in-one after a currently qualifying profitable piece capture
Veto a proven checked continuation when all qualifying offers stay unmoved and have unchanged raw legal exchange gain after preceding own move
new_proof_limits: Each of the two added board probes has its own512position cap. Existing EC/raw-offer work is not capped by these limits. No new engine searches.
missing_history_or_exhaustion: No history continuation veto without a completed proof; no mating-acceptance escape without a completed legal witness.
validation_policy: No candidate tuning using new labels; report fresh results even if worse. A failed candidate does not silently become a new candidate on the same test.
review: Independent Astra TypeScript/Python feature parity:618,zero mismatches; no critical semantic issues.

sources.use: Published distinction between endgame necessity and multiple middlegame options; no claim that our phase/material cutoffs are Chess.com thresholds.
Published sound piece-sacrifice and competitive-position criteria.
